footer.label: Footer
footer.askingRents: Asking rents from public listings, not official statistics.

layout.metaDescription: Describe the rental you need. RentThe6ix searches Toronto listings, checks each price against similar homes, and shows the neighbourhood around it.

say.title: Say it how you would say it.
say.prompt: 2-bed near UofT under $2,800, cat-friendly, with AC
say.caption: Every phrase becomes a filter you can change. Solid ones are must-haves; outlined ones only move a listing up or down.

start.title: Where do you want to live?

landing.title: Find a Toronto rental that fits, at a fair price
landing.subtitle: Describe what you need in your own words. We search listings from several sites, check each price against similar homes nearby, and show you the neighbourhood around it.
landing.promptLabel: Describe the place you're looking for
landing.promptPlaceholder: e.g. 2-bedroom near UofT under $2,800, 25 minutes by transit, cat-friendly, with AC

student.label: Student
student.prompt: Room or studio near York University under $1,300, close to the subway, furnished.

couple.label: Couple
couple.prompt: I need a 2-bedroom near UofT St. George under $2,800, within 25 minutes by transit, close to groceries, cat-friendly, and I really care about getting a good deal. I make about $95k with my roommate.

family.label: Family
family.prompt: 3 bedrooms in Scarborough under $3,200, near a public school and a park, parking.

areas.title: Explore neighbourhoods
areas.body: Rents, renters and housing pressure across Toronto's 158 neighbourhoods and 25 wards.

paste.title: Paste a listing
paste.body: Found a place on Facebook or anywhere else? Paste it to check the price and the area.

search.title: Results
search.noPrompt: Describe the place you're looking for to start a search.
search.basicSearch: AI wasn't used for this search
search.noResults: No listings match all of your must-haves. Try turning one into a preference.

errors.rate_limited: Too many searches at once. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.service_unavailable: Search isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.network_error: Couldn't reach RentThe6ix. Check your connection and try again.
errors.validation_error: We couldn't use that request. Try rewording it.
errors.search_timeout: This search took too long. Try fewer travel targets.
errors.search_capacity: Lots of people are searching right now. Try again shortly.
errors.search_routing_incomplete: We couldn't work out every travel time for this search. Try again shortly.
errors.search_job_expired: This search expired. Run it again.
errors.default: Something went wrong with this search. Try again.

search.slowHint: Searching thousands of listings can take a minute or two.

status.title: System status
status.comingSoon: Other system checks will appear here as those services are connected.

filters.label: Your filters
filters.legend: Solid chips are must-haves; outlined chips are preferences. Tap a chip to change it.
filters.mustHaveHelp: Must-haves hide listings that don't match. Preferences only change the ranking.
filters.minutesHelp: Leave empty for the default time.

panel.title: Filters
panel.description: Changes apply when you press Show results. Editing filters never calls AI.
panel.invalid: Some values don't fit together, for example a minimum above the maximum. Fix them to continue.
panel.hideUnconfirmed: Hide listings that don't confirm my must-haves
panel.hideUnconfirmedHelp: Listings often leave details out. By default they stay in the results, marked “not confirmed”.
panel.priceFairnessHelp: Compared with asking rents for similar listings nearby, not signed leases.
panel.travelHelp: Transit times use TTC schedules for a weekday at 8:30 am. Driving times assume no traffic.
panel.placePlaceholder: e.g. Union Station, UofT St. George
panel.notFound: We couldn't find “{query}”. Try a landmark or a full street address.
panel.lookupFailed: We couldn't look that place up right now. Try again.
panel.unresolved: We don't know exactly where this is yet, so no travel time is worked out for it.
panel.safetyHelp: Uses Toronto Police neighbourhood crime rates compared with the city rate. Off unless you turn it on. Rates describe whole neighbourhoods, not a street, a building or the people who live there.
panel.safetyHard: Only neighbourhoods below the city rate
panel.areaHelp: Areas come from your request. Picking neighbourhoods on a map comes with the explorer.

price.thin: Too few similar listings to compare
price.note: Compared with asking rents for {count} similar listings nearby, not signed leases.
price.noteThin: We compare with asking rents for similar listings nearby (not signed leases) and need at least 5 of them to give a label.

travel.straightLine: {km} km to {target} (straight-line, travel time not available)

map.label: Map of results
map.unavailable: The map couldn't load. The list has every result.

listing.title: Listing
listing.notFound: This listing isn't available any more. It may have been taken down on the source site.
listing.loadFailed: We couldn't load this listing right now.
listing.sourceNote: Contact the landlord and apply on the source site; RentThe6ix doesn't host listings.
listing.approxAddress: Exact address not shown by the source

why.omitted: Not scored for this search: {parts}. They count once you ask for them or the data exists.
why.sum: The parts add up to the total.

rent.basis: Based on {count} similar listings within {km} km, seen in the last {days} days. {confidence}.
rent.thin: Not enough data: {count} similar listings within {km} km (at least 5 are needed for a price label).
rent.asking: Compared with asking rents for similar listings, not signed leases.
rent.adjustments: Adjustments to compare like with like
rent.benchmarkNone: City-wide benchmark (Statistics Canada, CMHC) isn't loaded yet.
rent.mapNote: A map of these listings needs their locations, which aren't available yet.

travel.none: Add a place or an amenity in Filters to see travel times from here.
travel.note: Transit uses TTC schedules for a weekday at 8:30 am. Driving assumes no traffic. Straight-line distance is shown where a travel time isn't available yet, never as minutes.

safety.rate: Police-reported major crime here: {rate}× the city rate ({years} average, Toronto Police Service).
safety.noData: Police-reported crime rates for this neighbourhood aren't available.

building.none: No RentSafeTO record is available for this building yet. The City's RentSafeTO program covers apartment buildings with 3 or more storeys and 10 or more units; houses and smaller buildings aren't evaluated.

area.none: Neighbourhood facts (renters, rent burden, transit, development nearby) aren't loaded yet.
